name: Structural Property Rephrasing (Source/Sink)
description: The original problem explicitly states the graph is bipartite ("divided into two categories"). This rewrite replaces that cue with an equivalent directed-graph property: the ability to orient all edges such that every vertex is exclusively a source or exclusively a sink. This preserves the bipartite guarantee mathematically but requires the solver to deduce that this property defines a bipartite graph, defeating models that rely on keyword matching for "two categories".
